QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] Return to the Land of Warriors
QuestInfo.0: You've already find a key in the Land of Innocence. You should return to the #eLand of Warriors#n and search for a key there.\r\nReturn to the Land of Warriors by talking to #e#p9400205#.#n
QuestInfo.1: You return to the Land of Warriors only to find all the warriors collapsed on the ground. #p9400205# says the people in the Land of Warriors can only rest and recover their strength during the night.\r\n#eSummon the night using the sun-pulley.#n
QuestInfo.2: You returned to the Land of Warriors only to find all the warriors collapsed on the ground. You learned they could only rest during the night.\r\nAfter you summoned the night using the sun's pulley, they all started to feel better.
